Prior to venturing into the roofing industry, my background encompassed teaching customer service. While some companies simply hire roofers, I invest in honest individuals and train them to become proficient roofers. This approach ensures that our work is executed with precision while prioritizing our customers' satisfaction. Our team comprises highly skilled, trustworthy, and ethical professionals—those I would personally entrust with the roofing needs of my own home. Our primary focus is not to complete the highest number of roofing projects in town but to cultivate the utmost customer happiness and deliver the highest quality. With every roof we undertake, our reputation is on the line, which is why we are committed to doing things right. Mike Amyx, Owner Our Mission Within the roofing industry, we are unrivaled in our dedication to customer service. Our objective is to surpass customer expectations by consistently going the extra mile. We measure our success not by the number of roofs we install but by the number of customers who enthusiastically recommend us to their loved ones, friends, and neighbors and by their willingness to choose us again for their roofing needs. Key Aspects About Us At Royal Roofing, led by Mike Amyx, a native Texan, we have proudly served our clients since 1990. Over the years, our commitment to excellence has garnered recommendations from insurance companies and realtors alike. As a referral-based company, we have built our reputation on the satisfaction of past clients, who continue to trust us with their roofing needs. Our team consists of highly skilled master roofers, some of whom have been with us for over two decades, ensuring consistent quality and expertise in every project we undertake. Customer service is at the core of our values, and we prioritize meeting and exceeding our client's expectations. Demonstrating our financial stability, we hold an exceptional A+ credit rating with all of our suppliers, solidifying our position as a reliable and financially sound company. Having successfully completed over 12,000 roof installations, our track record speaks for itself. As insurance claim specialists, we possess the necessary expertise to handle complex insurance processes efficiently. We remain committed to staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in the roofing industry through continuous training and development. Our long-term presence in the field underscores our dedication to providing reliable and enduring roofing solutions. In cases where customers have been let down by other roofing companies or left in the lurch due to unfulfilled promises, we step in to offer support and rectify the situation. Rest assured; we prioritize the well-being of our clients and our employees. We are fully insured, maintaining a longstanding relationship with the same insurance company for 17 years. data.title: Royal Roofing Reviews - Richardson, TX | Angi

reviews.text: I recently had my roof and gutters replaced and I couldn’t be more impressed with the entire process from start to finish. Charlie and his team was professional, punctual and respectful of my house. They walked me through every step and gave me a detailed estimate. The crew was on time and kept my yard clean, free of nails and trash and most importantly safe. What really stood out to me was their attention to detail and pride in their work. My roof looks great and I’m confident knowing my new roof will last for years to come. If you’re looking for a reliable, honest and skilled roofing company than I’d highly recommend Charlie and Royal Roofing.
reviews.author: Kevin Patton

reviews.text: Royal Roofing was referred to me by a close friend who had a great experience with them.   I have had the same great experience - Charlie is a pro and knows what he is doing. He can work closely with insurance if needed and has prior experience as an adjuster.  Our new roof looks great and the crew got it done in 1 full day - they were all professional and cleaned up well after the job was done.   I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Steven Turner

reviews.text: We live in Trophy Club Texas and needed to replace our home’s asphalt shingle roof.  To weed out unscrupulous businesses we decided to only consider roofers who are accredited by the Better Business Bureau (BBB), and it worked out for us in the most wonderful way.  Charlie Kegans with Royal Roofing quoted us the best price of the five roofers who submitted bids.  On the day of the project everything worked out perfectly despite the incredible heat of Texas in July.  The crew was as professional and competent as Charlie said they would be.  We are thrilled with their work.  The day after the installation we had a good hour-long thunderstorm and downpour which made for a good stress test of their work, and the results were everything we could hope for.  If we ever need another roof replacement, we will only make one phone call, and it will be to Charlie Kegans at Royal Roofing.
reviews.author: Larry Chesnut

reviews.text: Royal Roofing has taken care of our roofing needs for over two decades and through several hail storms. We first met Royal Roofing when we needed some custom work, and other companies couldn’t do it. When we tried Royal Roofing, their sales rep, Charlie Kegans, took on the challenge and got the job done. We’ve worked with them ever since. Charlie is honest, straightforward, knows his stuff, works well with our insurance coverage, and keeps his word.
reviews.author: Bill Starnes

reviews.text: I highly recommend Royal Roofing for all of your roofing needs. Mike and his team were excellent to work with from start to finish. They communicated clearly about the process and timing for the installation, and they were always responsive to my questions. The installers were professional and efficient, and they did a great job of cleaning up after themselves. We had a small issue with our satellite dish, but it was quickly corrected. This is the second time we have used Royal Roofing, and we would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Greg Freeman

reviews.text: I am very impressed with Royal Roofing.  I am a contractor as well (not roofing).  We have partnered with Royal Roofing on several projects.  Their attention to detail, not only the details of the roof and the finished product, but also the safety of their crews and communication with the homeowners, is very hard to find nowadays.  This is a first class company, and I'm honored to recommend them and work with them.
reviews.author: Andrew Bush

reviews.text: Fantastic job as always. This was the second roof replacement Royal has done for us. They’re first class all the way. Charlie was super in keeping us informed of progress at every step. He worked with us to get the job done at the time that was most expedient for us. And after the job, Charlie took care of all the insurance paperwork!! I would not use any other company!!
reviews.author: Bobby D

reviews.text: We have had Royal replace or repair the roof on two different houses over the past 20 or so years and have been highly pleased with the projects.  Royal provides a fair price and performs top-flight work.  In fact, a neighbor stopped by to comment on having watched the work and was impressed with how thoroughly they cleaned up afterwards.  They do an amazing job and have held to that standard for many years.
reviews.author: David Meermans
